rationale:
Pros: The agent verified identity correctly using full name + ZIP, looked up the correct account and orders, and used the user’s default PayPal method when modifying an item. Requested item change appears to match an available beginner/low-piece variant.

Critical issues: The agent performed two order-changing writes without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which the policy requires. Specifically: (1) updated the shipping address for order #W9583042 without confirmation after restating the change, and (2) modified the jigsaw item on order #W4082615 without prior confirmation. Additionally, the agent stated the jigsaw order was “pending/not shipped” without clearly supported tool evidence in the visible transcript (status not shown in the snippet), risking unverified information. While the user initially hinted at correcting all addresses/profile, the agent didn’t confirm or address those broader updates; not strictly required, but the missing confirmation before writes alone fails the pass bar.

Result: Fails due to policy-violating writes without explicit confirmation and a potentially unsupported shipping-status statement.
